value.rationale: The exact full spectrum for a non-axisymmetric and geometrically natural spherical localization region gives all-dimensional benchmarks. The sharp threshold changes the maximizing eigenspace from one anisotropic quadratic to n-2 mixed modes, with an n-1 dimensional critical tie. This is structural, not merely a single computed eigenvalue, and the geometry and use of one exact harmonic degree are naturally motivated by Slepian concentration literature.
